# MatterDraft Studio

> MatterDraft Studio is a local-first desktop workspace in development for lawyers, advocates, chambers and legal teams preparing legal documents and indexed court bundles.

In development for Windows and macOS. Website examples use fictional data. Release timing has not been announced. Website policies are review drafts.

## Product

- [Product overview in Markdown](https://matterdraft.legal/index.md): Scope, intended workflows and limitations.
- [Product website](https://matterdraft.legal/): Public feature descriptions and interactive examples.
- [Early access](https://matterdraft.legal/#early-access): Current registration availability and terms of the early access offer.

## Optional

- [Complete text export](https://matterdraft.legal/llms-full.txt): A plain-text copy of the product overview.
